      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/net_processing.cpp and p2p tests to reject zero-input/zero-output transactions early during P2P message deserialization.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Protects nodes against peer-induced memory exhaustion during message deserialization. Malicious peers can currently send blocks packed with empty transactions to force massive CTransaction allocations or specify huge vector counts that trigger multi-megabyte reallocations."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch shared utility or serialization libraries like src/serialize.h or src/util, modifying transaction primitive headers instead.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The changes add domain-specific consensus limits into CTransaction deserialization rather than modifying generic serialization infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/primitives/transaction.h deserialization rules to enforce upper bounds on inputs and outputs based on maximum block sizes.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Bounds memory allocation for transaction primitives by enforcing that transactions claiming more inputs or outputs than could fit in a block fail deserialization immediately.
